title: Predicting Postoperative Lung Cancer Recurrence and Survival Using Cox Proportional Hazards Regression and Machine Learning
summary: Publisher full text read in Chrome, Methods and Results: retrospective cohort 309/512 NSCLC lung-resection patients; CT radiomic/body-composition features with Cox regression and ML (logistic/SVM among approaches), five-fold validation, AUC about .75–.77. Specific recurrence/survival association with no external cohort. Publisher also links a later comment/reply (Cancers 2025, 17(4), 697; 17(5), 727) critiquing limitations in variable interpretation; the reply acknowledges the issue and plans alternative approaches, which qualifies causal/mechanistic interpretation but does not negate the reported predictive association. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
